error: `count + 1` does not fit register `count` (uint<4>)
 --> width.weft:3:14

3 |     count := count + 1;
  |              ^^^^^^^^^ has values 1..=16
  = help: to wrap around, use `+%`: `count +% 1`
  = help: to keep the low 4 bits, write `(count + 1).trunc(4)`
note: uint<4> holds 0..=15
